name: mata-store
description: MATA Store monorepo. ONE Vercel project: frontend/ (Vite, static) + api/index.js (runs backend/app.js as a Vercel Function). See vercel.json and DEPLOY-VERCEL.md.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.description: MATA Store. One Vercel project: the Vite frontend (frontend/) is served as static files and the Express API (backend/) runs as a single Vercel Function via api/index.js. Backend and frontend each install their own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm ci && cd ../frontend && npm ci
